targeting.title: CSV Opens in One Column in Excel? Fix the Delimiter
targeting.metaTitle: CSV Opens in One Column in Excel? Fix the Delimiter
targeting.metaDescription: Fix a CSV opening in one Excel column. Choose the right delimiter, handle quoted commas, protect IDs and use Text to Columns without changing Windows settings.
targeting.excerpt: CSV stuck in column A? Import with the correct comma, semicolon or tab separator, check quoted fields, and keep IDs intact. A focused Excel guide with examples and safer alternatives to changing regional settings.
targeting.author: Ali Rehman
targeting.primary: csv opens in one column excel
targeting.keywords: csv opens in one column excel, excel csv not separating columns, csv semicolon excel, excel text to columns csv, csv delimiter excel, csv comma in quotes
targeting.summary: Import the original CSV through From Text/CSV and choose the actual delimiter before loading|Check quotes and column types separately so company names and identifiers stay intact|Use Text to Columns for intact worksheet records; avoid global separator changes for one file
